verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so CPU-architecture coverage is a fair question for it. The evidence only names Apple Silicon (M3+), Snapdragon Hexagon NPUs and mobile platforms. Nothing documents support for PowerPC or any CPU architecture beyond x86 and ARM, and the generic "whatever silicon the device has" tagline does not establish it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
